 AAA on FOX Results (10/17): La Catalina Appears, Tag Title Bout 
 Jeremy Lambert October 17, 2026, 11:26 pm 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 Lucha Libre AAA aired the latest episode of AAA on FOX on October 17. The event aired on Fox Latin America and YouTube .
 Full results are below.
 AAA on FOX Results (10/17)
 La Catalina opened the show, speaking about her AAA Reina de Reinas Title victory, saying she ended Flammer’s story and started her own. Las Toxicas interrupt and Flammer says her story will begin again. Catalina tried to cause tension, asking who was better between Maravilla and La Hiedra because that’s who she wanted to face. Flammer says she would talk to Rey Mysterio.
 Rey Mysterio says he would crown a number one contender for the Reina de Reinas Title by the end of the night after Flammer makes her case.
 Taurus def. El Fiscal
 Fiscal challenges Abismo Negro for Heroes Inmortales.
 La Hiedra makes her case for a title shot. Rey reiterates he’ll decide by the end of the night.
 Rey Mysterio announces La Catalina will defend the title against Flammer and La Hiedra.
 AAA World Tag Team Championships: Los Wagner Brothers (El Hijo del Dr. Wagner Jr. & Galeon) (c) def. El Mesias & Mecha Wolf to retain the titles.
 Perros Del Mal confront the Wagner Brothers. Mesias and Mecha attack the Wagners. Nino Hamburguesa, La Parka, and Mr. Iguana go after Perros.
 You can find results from around the wrestling world at Fightful’s results section .
